parent_objective: localize low-support offtrack-dominated outcomes without rerun
blocked_by: M2041 pivots from routing-smoke branch to no-rerun outcome localization
supersedes: direct ranking from sparse M2039 successes

public_gates: M2042 must not run new rollout or policy actions
M2042 must reproduce M2039 outcome counts exactly
M2042 must localize success/offtrack/collision by profile family source_kind proxy_template and generated_proxy
M2042 must decide comparison-ready slices versus repair/localization route
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not treat smoke proxy rows as paper-valid generated tasks

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns complete but low-support measured execution into localized repair/comparison evidence
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: no-rerun localization only; no new rollout ranking paper or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2039 outcome counts cannot be reproduced
stop if localization finds no actionable slices
stop if ranking is still low-support
stop if another narrow localization would not change route decision
fallback_plan: route to task-quality repair if offtrack dominance is broad
route to bounded comparison candidate qualification if supported slices exist
route to branch synthesis if results require broader route decision
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2041 pivots complete low-support execution to no-rerun localization

admission_evidence: M2041 synthesizes M2031-M2040 routing-smoke evidence and pivots to outcome localization
blocked_shortcuts: do not interpret localization as paper-level evidence
allowed_updates: M2042 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for task-quality repair, candidate qualification, or synthesis

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2042 localizes outcomes only and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No history-necessity test is run in M2042.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If no comparison-ready slice exists, route to repair or synthesis instead of ranking.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: localizes where complete measured execution has usable support versus offtrack dominance
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide whether to repair task quality or qualify bounded comparison slices
must_synthesize_if: M2042 finds only broad offtrack dominance
M2042 would route to another localization without new evidence

hypothesis: No-rerun localization can explain the sparse M2039 successes and choose a repair or comparison route without new rollout.
success_criteria: M2039 outcome counts are reproduced exactly
no new rollout ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: outcome counts do not match M2039
new rollout or ranking is performed
decision_rule: M2042 passes if it reproduces M2039 outcomes and emits clear localization and next-route evidence without new rollout.
